name: Scalix Cloud
summary: Provisions and manages Scalix Cloud resources including isolated sandboxes, persistent Linux computers, serverless PostgreSQL, functions, object storage, and AI inference.
description: Official Scalix Cloud MCP server over Streamable HTTP. Connects coding agents to serverless PostgreSQL (ScalixNova), serverless functions, isolated sandboxes, persistent Linux computers, object storage, and AI inference using a single API key read from SCALIX_API_KEY.
author: Scalix World
